Dear Brightline Studio Inc.,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to kindly request that you send a renewed certificate of insurance before January 15, 2027, when the earliest policy expires. The policies in question are as follows:

Commercial General Liability GL-5521904 (expires January 15, 2027);
Umbrella Liab UM-7730418 (expires March 1, 2027).

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME] on behalf of Harborview Properties LLC
